Hi Sam,

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep-dive to walk through the proposed integration points and architecture. We want to make sure a senior leader from your side (CTO or Head of Platform) can attend for 30–45 minutes so we can align on tradeoffs and rollout cadence. On our side, Marcus Lin (VP Eng) and Evelyn Hart (Solutions Lead) plan to join.

Attached is a short agenda and a high-level system diagram to give context. Can you confirm which of these slots works for your exec? Times below are in PDT:

- Tue 2026-06-15, 09:00–09:45
- Wed 2026-06-16, 11:00–11:45
- Thu 2026-06-17, 14:00–14:45

If none of those work, please propose two alternatives next week. Also let me know if you prefer a separate 1:1 with your exec beforehand for pre-reads.

Agenda (attached):
- 10m: high-level goals and constraints
- 20m: proposed integration flow (PKI, data flow, auth)
- 10m: questions and next steps

Attachments: arch-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (1 page), mvp-system-diagram.png (1 image)

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Of your proposed slots, the closest fit would be Thu 2026-06-17 morning (we can do 09:30–10:00 PDT instead of your afternoon slot). Alternatively, Mon 2026-06-21 09:00–09:30 PDT would also work.

Two questions:
1) Can you make sure we cover data residency and key management (KMS/HSM) in the first 10 minutes — our security team flagged that as a must-see.
2) Will there be a dial-in and recorded option? We want to capture for the broader platform team.

If you want, I can loop our Head of Platform (cc'd via ops@...) once we lock the time.

—Sam
